resources.string: Activates Offline Assistant's microphone when the steering-wheel assistant button is pressed.
Enable Wheel Mic Helper in Android Accessibility settings so the steering-wheel assistant button can activate Offline Assistant's microphone.
Restart recovery is ready. The helper restores only its own Accessibility service and leaves other enabled services unchanged.
Optional recovery permission. If this HU forgets Accessibility after restart, run once from a computer with ADB: adb shell pm grant com.example.wheelmic android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
Wheel Mic Helper is off. Turn it on in Android Accessibility settings.
Grant the optional recovery permission once with ADB, then turn this option on.
WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS permission is required for restart recovery.
Enable Wheel Mic Helper in Accessibility settings first.
